The '''Acidic Paragon Vibro Axe''' was a type of [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]] in use sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As with most [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], the weapon contained an [[Ultrasonic generator/Legends|ultrasonic vibration generator]] in the handle that granted the user far greater cutting power. However, the Acidic Paragon Vibro Axe was unique because the blade had tiny micro-pores in it that exuded a corrosive [[Acid/Legends|acid]]. Each strike would apply acid to the affected area, softening it up and making each subsequent blow from the weapon much more damaging.
